items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, and multiple stored XSS issues leading to arbitrary code execution. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to unauthenticated account takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications have emerged that threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to arbitrary code execution
items.summary: This stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin covers 13 vulnerabilities, with eight rated critical, including CVE-2026-48358, an unauthenticated, zero-interaction flaw in the webhooks component that can lead to arbitrary code execution. The update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via webhooks
items.summary: Rated with a CVSS score of 10.0, this critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated arbitrary code execution through improper output encoding in the webhooks component. No account or login is required for exploitation.

items.title: Vulnerability allowing malicious file planting on the server
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows an attacker to plant malicious files on the server.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw (CVSS 9.3) in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. Attacks exploiting this vulnerability started the same day the patch was released.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows unauthenticated PHP object injection via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie, which can lead to remote code execution. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) to address the flaw.
